title: Query probability under symmetrization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube, let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing $f$ with sign-valued inputs and outputs, and let $pi$ be a probability distribution on the sign alphabet. For each coordinate $i$, the probability that the symmetrized tree queries $i$ under the independent product input distribution is the average, over the uniform distribution on the permutation group preserving $f$, of the query probability of $T$ at the coordinate obtained by applying the inverse permutation to $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$T$ computes $f$ and has sign-valued inputs and outputs
$T$ has a finite nonempty seed space and seed probability law
$pi$ is a probability distribution on the sign alphabet
